messages:
maria_pm: heads-up — AcmeHealth asked for a tightened Optimize toolkit MVP: batching heuristics + cache prescriptive rules + a simple quantization fallback. They want pilot in 6 weeks. thoughts?
aj_eng: 6 weeks is tight. which of the three is non-negotiable for them?
sarah_cs: Acme said batching + cache are highest priority. quantization is a 'nice to have' but they'd accept a simple fallback plan.
leo_ml: for quantization we can offer a recommended profile (int8) and a fallback to fp16 model variant. but inference regressions must be validated with eval hooks.
emily_se: from field POV: customers want clear runbooks and a small set of signals that trigger a rollback. eval-triggered alerts were mentioned — can we define those now?
tom_product: proposal: scope MVP = (1) adaptive batching presets for mobile & server; (2) cache policy templates (prefix-level & KV TTLs); (3) quant fallback documented but gated behind pilot acceptance.
aj_eng: ok. need to call out SLO targets for batching (p95 latency increase threshold). if batching causes >10% p95 regression versus baseline, we disable.
leo_ml: agree. suggest eval-triggered alert stub:
```
EVAL_ALERT: name=token-concordance-drop
trigger_if: concordance_delta <= -5% over sample N=500
action: notify #product, rollback batching -> baseline
```
that keeps it deterministic for the pilot.
sarah_cs: that's great. we need wording for customer-facing acceptance criteria. short bullets we can share in the pilot agreement.
maria_pm: draft acceptance bullets: 
- Pilot includes 3 customers incl. AcmeHealth.
- Batching: <=10% p95 latency regression on targeted routes; measurable cost savings >=15% for batched requests.
- Cache: hit-rate >=20% on prefix cache within 2 weeks of pilot.
- Quant fallback: documented steps + automated rollback; no silent quality regressions (eval alerts).
- Eval alerts: thresholded as Leo suggested, + daily digest to ops.
tom_product: add rollout policy: canary to 5% traffic, monitor 24h, then 25%, 72h, full. auto-fallback if eval alert fires.
emily_se: +1. For docs we need examples for mobile (short prompts) and server (longer context) batching presets. I can draft sample prompts.
aj_eng: engineering ask: will the runtime support mixed batching (mobile short + server long) in same pool? that changes kernel selection.
leo_ml: runtime can prioritize by max_seq bins, but need config surface: batching_bucket = { "short": 32, "long": 8 } and route metadata to pick bin.
emily_se: can we make the config change user-visible? customers like toggles.
aj_eng: we can expose presets: `preset: mobile-short`, `preset: server-long`. internals map to bins.
sarah_cs: legal wants data retention note in pilot: cache is allowed only for non-PII routes. we should add a guard.
maria_pm: noted. add to acceptance: pilot must include explicit route-level consent and we ship sample opt-out code.
leo_ml: acceptance test plan (engineering-facing) quick sketch: 
1) run preserved baseline on commit X
2) enable batching presets, run synthetic load 100k requests, measure p95, cost per token
3) run eval set of 2k prompts, compute concordance and log alerts
4) enable cache, measure hit-rate and stale eviction behavior
5) test quant fallback by swapping in int8 artifact and verify evaluation metrics <=2% quality delta or trigger rollback

aj_eng: looks good. estimate: batching + cache core work = 4 weeks eng + 1 week testing/docs. quant fallback + eval hooks = 2-3 weeks after. total ~6-8 weeks depending on parallelization.
tom_product: we need prioritization: if timeline slips, scope trim -> remove quant and only deliver quant doc + manual rollback (no auto-switch). keep eval alerts.
emily_se: customer comms note: prepare 1-pager + sample config and a small SDK snippet for toggling presets.
sarah_cs: I'll confirm AcmeHealth timeline and whether they can accept staged rollout. also will surface legal constraints.
maria_pm: action items:
- @aj_eng estimate concrete PR/epic (due EOD Fri)
- @leo_ml write eval-alert rule templates (due Tue)
- @emily_se draft customer 1-pager + SDK snippets (due Wed)
- @sarah_cs confirm pilot customers & legal constraints (due Thu)
- @tom_product finalize rollout gating text (add canary steps) (due Fri)

release-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-toolkit/pilot-config v0.1 -> staging at 2025-02-12T09:00:00Z :rocket:
maria_pm: thanks all. leaning to greenlight scope as Tom proposed, with quant as deferred-auto. please update tickets and we'll sync Wed 10am for pilot sign-off. :thumbsup:
